{{Quote|As far as the grenades, there are some Imperial Military Grade Grenade Casing Units. The Imps call them IMGGCUs. Just one of these would be very valuable.|[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Moore]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SwSMA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Speak with Sergeant Moore, again|Lok}}</ref>}}
An '''Imperial Military Grade Grenade Casing Unit''', aslo known as '''IMGGCU''', was a [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]]-based weapon that was being researched in the [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] [[Imperial Research Facility (Lok)|Imperial Research Facility]] some time after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:SwSMA" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Nym/Legends|Nym's]] [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]], the most powerful criminal organization on Lok, learned from the corrupted Imperial [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Moore]] that IMGGCU development had achieved completion.<ref name="SWG:SwSMA" /> Nym's [[First Mate/Legends|first mate]] [[Kole]] thus tasked a group of spacers to raid the Imperial Research Facility. The Lok Revenants then stole a crate of IMGGCU prototypes and brought them back to [[Nym's Stronghold]].<ref name="SWG:RtrdaI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Retrieve the research data and IMGGCUs|Lok}}</ref>
